# RF0 synthetic two-path profile fixture

Every `.log` in this directory is an artificial, minimal Gaussian-like text sample written for the RF0 screenshot and renderer baseline. These files are not generated by Gaussian and do not establish compatibility with real Gaussian output.

Each path has its own four source files and eight independent project node UUIDs. The Gibbs total values use a shared absolute baseline of −150 Eh per path. Target relative display values are A: 0, +15.060, −5.020, −15.688 and B: 0, +11.420, −2.800, −12.400 kcal/mol. Values are derived through the project's CODATA 2022 conversion constant; the rounded labels are not hardcoded into runtime plotting.

Run `python tools/build_profile_replica_fixture.py` to build `artifacts/rf0/profile-replica.grproj` and validate its calculation payload. The generated project is an artifact, not the production default project.
